## GRLS deprivation linkage

This workflow links both veterinary-clinic and owner home ZIP codes to county-level 2019 Multidimensional Deprivation Index (MDI) values.

- Clinic ZIP is the first five digits of `vet_address.csv::postal_code`. This explicitly handles ZIP+4 values.
- Owner ZIP is the most frequently recorded `house_details.csv::primary_zip_code` for each dog. On ties, the first observed ZIP is retained to preserve the established analysis definition.
- MDI quintiles are calculated across all counties in `MDI_2019.csv` before being applied to clinic and owner counties.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
source(here::here("R", "deprivation.R"))

clinics <- read.csv(here::here("Data", "vet_address.csv"))
owner_addresses <- read.csv(here::here("Data", "house_details.csv"))
zip_lookup <- read.csv(here::here("Data", "uszips.csv"))
mdi <- read.csv(
  here::here("Data", "MDI_2019.csv"),
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM"
)

deprivation <- build_deprivation_dataset(
  clinics,
  owner_addresses,
  zip_lookup,
  mdi
)

write.csv(
  deprivation,
  here::here("Output", "GRLS_dogs_MDI_2019.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
